review_evidence: The 42 primary files define zkLean circuit/semantics machinery plus concrete SHA3/boolean circuit specifications and proofs.
The extensive `examples/` tree was retained because it contains actual circuit definitions, specs and proof statements rather than disposable demos.
zkLean/zkLean/SimpSets.lean registers project-specific simp interfaces used by the formalization and is retained.
summary: Reviewed zkLean and retained all 42 primary files; examples and simp-registration support contain reusable formal circuit/proof interfaces.
